evidence: Read-only discovery on 2026-09-29 (scripts/signup-selectors.ts, session arm — windowed Chrome) and a page check the same day confirming an account signup, not a mailing list: JetBlue's /trueblue/signup, 'Sign Up' with full name, email, birthday and phone. Nothing was typed or submitted. A driven attempt through the proxy the same day (tunnel egress from a US VPN address): names, email, phone and postal code took vault tokens, the birthday was typed, the country picked; the first submit opened a generic error dialog (app-error-dialog: an apology and 'try again later', naming no field), and after closing it two further submits, by click and by Enter, produced no visible change. No password step was reached and no mail was sent. Whether JetBlue refused the data or the address is undetermined.
gotchas: No password field on this page; how the password is set after Sign Up was not observed — look at the next screen before filling it.
The form also requires a birthday (#BirthDayM, #BirthDayD, #BirthDayY) and a phone number; they are the account owner's to supply.
The birthday fields are plain text inputs and take literal values (month, day, four-digit year).

Country is a custom picker, not a select: click the button labelled 'Select Country' (button[aria-haspopup] beside the 'Country' label), then click the entry inside the [role="listbox"] whose own text is the country name (e.g. [role="listbox"] *:text-is("United States")). Clicking the [role="option"] element by exact text did not resolve; the inner text node did. A stale 'select a country' hint can stay visible after a successful pick.

Phone is input[type="tel"] and required; fill it with the identity's national-number token. Postal Code is labelled optional but was flagged aria-invalid on submit after a fill that matched no selector; fill it with the address ZIP token to be safe (it is the text input following the phone).
A cookie banner (button 'Accept') covers the bottom of the page at load.

After submit the page can open a modal app-error-dialog with a generic apology and no field named; it intercepts clicks on the Sign Up button until closed (button[aria-label*="close" i] inside it). On 2026-09-29 the submits after closing it did nothing visible, so a run that meets this dialog should stop and record it rather than retry.
